description: Fetches cruise schedule and itinerary details from Travel Weekly's cruise database (www.travelweekly.com/Cruise/...). Target pages contain structured cruise records including departure dates, itinerary ports, duration, and pricing.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_cruise: Fetch cruise details from a Travel Weekly cruise page; 参数: url, cruise_id, cruise_line, ship_name; 必填: 无

url.description: Full Travel Weekly cruise URL (e.g., https://www.travelweekly.com/Cruise/Viking-Ocean/Viking-Venus/Cruise-p60587758). Used by get_cruise.

cruise_id.description: Cruise ID from the URL (numeric portion after 'Cruise-p'). Used by get_cruise when url is not provided.

cruise_line.description: Cruise line name for URL construction (e.g., 'Viking Ocean'). Required with cruise_id if url not provided.

ship_name.description: Ship name for URL construction (e.g., 'Viking Venus'). Required with cruise_id if url not provided.
